Legendary Tornadus (Japanese: VSトルネロスれいじゅうフォルムI VS I), titled VS Tornadus Therian Forme I in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 532nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the eighth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Tornadus: Therian Forme I (Japanese: レジェンダリー・トルネード Legendary Tornado) in the VIZ Media translation and Legendary Tornadus in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
plainText:
Legendary Tornadus (Japanese: VSトルネロスれいじゅうフォルムI VS I), titled VS Tornadus Therian Forme I in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 532nd chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the eighth chapter of the .

It is subtitled Tornadus: Therian Forme I (Japanese: レジェンダリー・トルネード Legendary Tornado) in the VIZ Media translation and Legendary Tornadus in the Shogakukan Asia translation.

==Plot==
 

Whitley is dreaming about N. She runs up to a silhouette of N in her old Team Plasma outfit. The silhouette tells her to smile and she hugs him. The silhouette praises Whitley for giving him strength. She looks towards the silhouette, confused. The silhouette is revealed to be Blake and she screams. Her dorm room neighbors hear her scream and go to check on her to see if a pervert or Hugh is in her room. She wakes up with all the commotion and tells her neighbors that she had a scary dream. She shuts the door and talks to Foongy about the dream and how she might be falling for Blake and not for N. She then realizes she's lost her pendant of N.

==Major events==

Blake and Whitley are attacked by , which proceeds to turn into its Therian Forme.
Blake is revealed to have caught , nicknaming it "Kelden".
